annotations.title: Get a listen link for a track

description: Get an AINSOF link to hear a complete track preview. The AINSOF link obtains a fresh temporary storage address when opened; it remains usable while that preview is available.

track_id.description: e.g. 'AIN-CAT 053_004' — or the title, e.g. 'Shine On Today'
